content.text:
I've re-engineered the `components` (plain HTML) scaffold in `packages/scaffold/templates/components/`.

**What changed and why:**

The old scaffold put a giant markup string inside `src/main.ts` and injected it with `innerHTML`. That's the anti-pattern you flagged: no view-source content, a flash of an empty page, worse accessibility/SEO, and it forces every future edit to happen inside a JS template literal instead of real HTML.

The modern, dev-friendly shape for a plain HTML/CSS/TS(Vite) app is the same one Vite's own vanilla-ts template and the rest of pantoken's own framework scaffolds (Vue, Angular, Svelte) already use — markup lives where its language is native, and JS is reserved for behavior:

- [templates/components/index.html](packages/scaffold/templates/components/index.html) now contains the actual page shell (the same `@pantoken/plugin-layouts` "wrapper" markup, generated the identical way Vue/Angular/Svelte templates already do it) — no `#app` div, no injection.
- [templates/components/src/main.ts.tmpl](packages/scaffold/templates/components/src/main.ts.tmpl) is now just the pantoken CSS/interactions imports plus a comment marking where to add interactive JS/TS.
- Added `src/style.css` for the user's own app-specific styles, imported from `main.ts` (the standard Vite convention).
- Updated the template's README to describe the new file responsibilities.

I regenerated `generated/scaffolds.ts` (`vp run generate`) and confirmed with a fresh scaffold to a temp dir plus the `@pantoken/scaffold` and `create-pantoken-app` test suites (all passing, 84 + 8 tests). Added a changeset for the user-visible change.

This only touches the template source in this repo — `test1/` is a generated artifact and isn't something to hand-edit; regenerating it (`npx create-pantoken-app` → `components`) once this ships will produce the new structure.

**Root cause of the gap:** the template source (`templates/components/index.html`, `main.ts.tmpl`) was correctly migrated, but `packages/scaffold/dist/` — the actual compiled output that `create-pantoken-app`'s CLI imports via the package's `exports` field — was stale from before the change. Fixed by rebuilding:
- Ran `vp run build` in `packages/scaffold` (which reran `scan-presets` → `generate` → `vp pack`, and this time `generate` correctly reported a cache miss on `index.html` and re-inlined it).
- Verified end-to-end by calling `scaffoldProject("components", …)` against the freshly built `dist/index.mjs` — confirmed `index.html` now contains the real `<div class="container">…` app shell and `src/main.ts` is just imports.
- Re-ran the `@pantoken/scaffold` test suite (84 tests) to confirm no regressions.

No further source changes were needed — `dist`/`generated` are gitignored build artifacts, rebuilt automatically at publish time, so this was purely a local verification gap, not a missing commit.

content.text:
No hits — the scaffold `style.css` finding is gone.

**Fix:** generalized the existing `dynamicallyLoaded` entry in [.fallowrc.jsonc](.fallowrc.jsonc#L71) from a single hardcoded path (`packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/app.css`) to a glob covering the whole templates tree (`packages/scaffold/templates/**/*.css`). Every scaffold template's CSS is only reachable through a sibling `.tmpl` entry file that fallow can't trace as a real entry point (same reason the existing `ignoreUnresolvedImports` rule already special-cases `/src/main.ts`), so this was a systemic gap, not a one-off — the new glob prevents every future template `.css` file from tripping the same "unused file" finding, not just this one.

Note: a second, unrelated finding (`unused-export:packages/scaffold/src/locale.ts:32:resolveSupportedLocale`) also showed up in the gate output — that's from pre-existing uncommitted changes to `locale.ts` not part of this change, so I left it alone. Flag if you want that addressed too.
